items.summaryEn: Lando Norris claimed pole position for the second grand prix in a row, beating the Mercedes drivers in a closely-fought qualifying session.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯连续第二场大奖赛夺得杆位，在激烈的排位赛中击败了梅赛德斯车手。
在Q3决定性的时刻，由于担心下雨，领先的车手们匆忙完成最后一轮。诺里斯在第一轮后暂列杆位，领先乔治·拉塞尔，两人上赛道进行最后一轮时，诺里斯奋力将对手挡在身后。
两人都跟在另一位梅赛德斯车手安德烈亚·基米·安东内利之后，安东内利在最后一轮跑出最快。然而诺里斯以超过0.1秒的优势击败了他的时间，随后拉塞尔夹在两人之间。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里确保梅赛德斯动力赛车占据前四名。
法拉利车手赌天气，在对手之后完成最后一轮。刘易斯·汉密尔顿击败了队友的时间，两人将共享第三排发车位。红牛双雄占据第四排，利亚姆·劳森在回归车队后表现出色，单圈仅比马克斯·维斯塔潘慢0.1秒。
角田裕毅在回归F1后未能与队友阿维德·林德布拉德一起进入Q3。林德布拉德位列第十，排在加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托之后，后者在第一轮跑得很慢，并在Tarzan弯出口出现严重转向过度，惊险通过第一轮。
两位阿尔派车手都未能进入Q3，包括受益于车队升级的皮埃尔·加斯利。他差0.1秒未能晋级。尼科·霍肯伯格也在Q2被淘汰。
亚历山大·阿尔本成为唯一进入Q2的威廉姆斯车手，以百分之几秒的优势击败队友小卡洛斯·塞恩斯。两辆升级后的阿斯顿·马丁都在第一轮出局，排在奥利弗·贝尔曼和两辆凯迪拉克之前。
detailEn: Lando Norris claimed pole position for the second grand prix in a row, denying the Mercedes drivers in a closely-fought session.

The front-running drivers hurried to complete their final runs as rain threatened to fall during the deciding moments of Q3. Norris, who held provisional pole position ahead of George Russell following the first runs, raced to keep his rival behind him after they joined the track for their final runs.

Both followed Andrea Kimi Antonelli in the other Mercedes who went fastest with his final run. Norris beat his time by more than a tenth of a second, however, then Russell split the pair of them. Oscar Piastri ensured Mercedes-powered cars filled the top four places.

The Ferrari drivers gambled with the weather and completed their final runs after their rivals. Lewis Hamilton beat his team mate’s time and the pair will share the third row of the grid. The Red Bull duo claimed the fourth row, Liam Lawson impressively lapping just a tenth of a second slower than Max Verstappen on his return to the team.

Yuki Tsunoda could not join his team mate Arvid Lindblad in Q3 on his return to Formula 1. Lindblad took 10th on the grid behind Gabriel Bortoleto, who scraped through the first round after a slow first run and a significant snap of oversteer at the exit of Tarzan.
Neither Alpine driver made the cut for Q3, including Pierre Gasly who had the benefit of the team’s upgrade. He fell short by a tenth of a second. Nico Hulkenberg also dropped out in Q2.

Alexander Albon was the only Williams driver to reach Q2, beating team mate Carlos Sainz Jnr by a few hundredths of a second. Both of the upgraded Aston Martins went out in the first round, ahead of Oliver Bearman and the two Cadillacs.

items.originalTitle: 大卫·库特哈德：维斯塔潘续约红牛让F1对手“松了一口气”
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver David Coulthard says Max Verstappen's decision to extend his contract with Red Bull until the end of 2030 has left the F1 paddock collectively breathing a sigh of relief.
detailZh: 大卫·库特哈德表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛的新合同让F1的对手们“松了一口气”。
大卫·库特哈德说，马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛的新合同会让其他F1车手感到如释重负。
前车手大卫·库特哈德表示，在马克斯·维斯塔潘决定与红牛建立合同延长之后，整个F1围场都可以“松一口气”。
维斯塔潘与红牛在他的主场比赛周末之前达成了新协议，这份合同将让他在这支位于米尔顿凯恩斯的车队效力至2030年底。
在赞德福特荷兰大奖赛周末之前，库特哈德在最新一期 Up To Speed 播客节目中，谈到了这位四届世界冠军的新合同所带来的连锁反应，并分享了他的看法。
“我要说的是，其他任何可能合同到期的车手都会松一口气，因为当像马克斯·维斯塔潘这样的车手在和所有顶级车队谈判时，你就会受到威胁，”这位前车手解释道。
“我在与迈凯伦的第一份合同中有[一个条款]，他们可以用迈克尔·舒马赫替换我，显然我对此并不太高兴。”
“在我与迈凯伦的第二份合同里没有这一条，但从威廉姆斯转到迈凯伦时，罗恩（丹尼斯）希望保留机会和可能性，以便能够得到迈克尔，因为很明显，在那个时候他正处于职业生涯起步阶段、是一颗冉冉升起的新星。”
在维斯塔潘宣布合同消息之前，这位荷兰车手一直被传可能加盟梅赛德斯或迈凯伦。
"乔治·拉塞尔可以松一口气了，"库特哈德补充道，他指的是这位梅赛德斯车手，此前有传闻称他的位置受到威胁。
"我知道基米·安东内利说过他不介意，但年轻的好处就是你不知道自己不知道什么。我认为对任何人来说，维斯塔潘都会是一个极其难缠的队友。"
维斯塔潘宣布合同消息的同一周，威廉姆斯车队确认与亚历克斯·阿尔本和卡洛斯·塞恩斯续约。
detailEn: Max Verstappen's Red Bull deal leaves F1 rivals "breathing a sigh of relief", says David Coulthard
David Coulthard says Max Verstappen’s new Red Bull contract will come as a relief to rival F1 drivers
The Formula 1 paddock can collectively "breathe a sigh of relief" following Max Verstappen's decision to sign a contract extension with Red Bull, according to former driver David Coulthard.
Verstappen and Red Bull agreed on a new deal ahead of his home race weekend, which will keep him racing with the Milton Keynes outfit until the end of 2030.

Speaking on the latest episode of the Up To Speed podcast ahead of the Dutch Grand Prix weekend at Zandvoort, Coulthard offered his perspective on the ripple effects of the four-time champion's new deal.

"I'll tell you who will be breathing a sigh of relief is any other driver that was potentially out of contract because when you've got a Max Verstappen talking to all of the top teams, then you are going to be under threat," the former driver explained.
"I had [a clause] in my first contract with McLaren that they could replace me for Michael Schumacher, and obviously I wasn't particularly happy about that.

"It wasn't there in my second contract with McLaren, but going from Williams to McLaren, Ron [Dennis] wanted to keep the opportunity and the possibility of being able to get Michael, who clearly at that stage was a rising guy at the beginning of his journey."
Prior to Verstappen's contract announcement, the Dutchman had been linked with Mercedes or McLaren.
"George [Russell] will be breathing a sigh of relief," Coulthard added, referencing the Mercedes driver whose position had been rumoured to be under threat.
"I know Kimi [Antonelli] said he wouldn't have minded, but the benefit of youth is you don't know what you don't know. I think Max would be a formidable team-mate for anyone."
Verstappen's contract announcement came in the same week that Williams confirmed extensions for both Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯：迈凯伦赛车低速弯表现糟糕
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯表示，迈凯伦赛车在低速弯道中的表现“糟糕”，并怀疑车队目前能否改善这一弱点。

media.altZh: 诺里斯：迈凯伦赛车低速弯表现糟糕

items.originalTitle: 诺里斯：迈凯伦赛车在低速弯表现“糟糕”
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris says McLaren's car is "pretty terrible" in slow corners and doubts the team can improve this weakness for now.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯表示，迈凯伦在赞德沃特的表现凸显了赛车在低速弯道中的弱点。
这位卫冕世界冠军赢得了上一站匈牙利大奖赛，该赛道有几个中低速弯，但他认为赞德沃特更慢的弯道组合对MCL40来说是个问题。
“我们在布达佩斯就知道，我们在高速弯非常出色，在低速弯相当糟糕，但我们还是设法赢了，”他说。“这里有很多非常非常低速的弯，我们的问题暴露得更多。所以这完全不意外。这正是我们预料到的。”
迈凯伦在赞德沃特为赛车带来了进一步升级。诺里斯表示这些升级表现符合预期，但车队在某些赛道上仍与对手有明显差距。
“它们完全按预期工作，所以我很高兴，”他说。“我们仍然取得了进步。
“只是在某些区域我们远远不够快。低速弯，我们整个周末都在挣扎，这显然是目前赛车的弱点。我觉得如果现在回到摩纳哥，我们会像之前一样糟糕。
“所以我认为我们显然进步了很多，尤其是在中高速弯，这就是我们在这里很快的原因，也是我们在布达佩斯那么快的原因。并不是我们在布达佩斯每个地方都快，所以才赢了。低速弯，我们仍然比法拉利慢，和梅赛德斯差不多。
“所以我们仍有弱点，尽管我们赢了一场比赛。只是优势在那里非常突出，而这里低速弯的差距太大了。”
诺里斯在今天的冲刺赛中与乔治·拉塞尔并列头排发车，但最终落后于查尔斯·勒克莱尔获得第三。他怀疑迈凯伦目前无法对赛车低速弯的糟糕表现做出任何重大改变。
“我们现在对此无能为力。赛车暂时就是这样。
“这是我们作为团队仍需专注的地方。我们会努力榨取一切。我觉得我今天做得不错，即使是P3。
“我只是想争夺头名，向前冲，追上乔治并给他施加压力，而不是在每个低速弯中求生存、拼命挣扎。
“所以我对团队和我们取得的进步非常满意，升级都起作用了，它们让我今天拿到P3。但如果我们想争夺冠军，我们还需要更多。”
detailEn: McLaren’s performance in Zandvoort highlights their car’s weakness in slow corners, says Lando Norris.

The reigning world champion won the previous round at the Hungaroring, a circuit which has several low-to-medium-speed corners, but he believes the slower mix of corners at Zandvoort is a problem for the MCL40.

“We knew in Budapest we’re very good in high-speed corners and we’re pretty terrible in slow speed, but we still managed to win,” he said. “Here there’s a lot more of the very, very slow speed and more of our problems show. So [it’s] not a surprise at all. It’s exactly what we expected.”
McLaren have brought further upgrades for their car in Zandvoort. Norris said these have performed as expected but the team still has a significant deficit to its rivals at some circuits.
“They’ve done exactly as they should, so I’m very happy,” he said. “We still managed to progress.

“It’s just [in] certain areas we’re just nowhere near quick enough. The slow speed, we’ve just struggled the whole weekend and seems clearly the weakness we have in the car at the minute. I feel if we still went back to Monaco now, we’re going to be shocking, as we were.

“So I think we’ve clearly progressed a lot, and especially in medium and high-speed, which is why we’re quick here, why we were so quick in Budapest. It wasn’t like we were quick everywhere in Budapest, and that’s why we won. The slow speed, we were still slower than Ferrari and matching Mercedes just about.
“So we still have weaknesses, even though we managed to win one race. It’s just the strengths really shone there, and here it’s just the deficit is too big in the slow speed.”

Norris qualified second on the grid for today’s sprint race alongside George Russell but fell to third behind Charles Leclerc. He doubts McLaren can make any significant changes to the car’s poor performance in low-speed corners for the time being.
“There’s just nothing we can do about it now. It’s just how the car is for the time being.
“That’s where we still have to focus as a team. We’ll try and get everything out of it. I feel like I still did a good job today, even with the P3.

“It’s just [that] I want to be fighting for top spot and be fighting and going forward and catching George and putting him under pressure rather than trying to survive in every slow-speed corner and fighting for my life.
“So I’m very happy with the team and the progress we made, and the upgrades have all worked, and they’ve allowed me to be P3 today. But we just need more if we want to fight for a championship.”
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯在赞德沃特冲刺赛排位第二，正赛跌至第三，落后于拉塞尔和勒克莱尔。

诺里斯认为赛车在中高速弯表现强劲，但低速弯是明显弱点，目前无法做出重大改变。
keyPointsEn: Norris qualified second for the Zandvoort sprint but fell to third behind Russell and Leclerc.
McLaren brought upgrades to Zandvoort; Norris said they performed as expected but the team still has a significant deficit at some circuits.

items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc overtook Lando Norris for second place on lap 18 of the Zandvoort sprint and held the position to the finish, attributing the pass mainly to differences in energy deployment.
detailZh: "要么非常正确，要么大错特错"——夏尔·勒克莱尔解释法拉利为荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛做出的大胆选择
勒克莱尔承认，在选择软胎后，他在发车区时曾感到担忧，但他强调法拉利的正赛节奏总体上很强。他表示排位赛是一个"弱点"，而在赞德沃特无法弥补
尽管在赞德沃特举行的F1冲刺赛几乎没有太多精彩场面，但夏尔·勒克莱尔完成了为数不多的几次超车之一。这位摩纳哥车手成功超越兰多·诺里斯升至第二位，并最终以这个名次完赛
据勒克莱尔所说，那次超车主要是由于能量输出管理的差异造成的，不过考虑到他的轮胎选择，他能在24圈中的第18圈完成超越仍然相当了不起
毕竟，勒克莱尔是仅有的两名选择用软胎起步、来跑这个周末最短的一场比赛的车手之一。这一选择基于练习赛的数据，以及法拉利本周末在轮胎衰退方面总体表现不错的事实——至少在勒克莱尔这一边是如此。
不过，勒克莱尔承认，当他在发车区看到周围所有车手都排着队使用中性胎时，他多少有些担心。
"每当你成了唯一做某件事的人，结果要么非常正确，要么大错特错，"勒克莱尔微笑着说。
"我认为最终这是个好的选择，所以这是积极的。这说明我们在第一次自由练习中把功课做扎实了，但说实话，站在发车区的时候，我只是希望自己做出了正确的选择。"
勒克莱尔在冲刺赛末段依然保持良好的比赛节奏，这让其他车队感到惊讶。
这个决定是与车队共同做出的，尽管勒克莱尔强调这并不是一个容易的决定。
“嗯，这不是因为我和刘易斯（汉密尔顿）采用了两种不同的策略，所以这肯定不是显而易见的选择。”
“不过，我认为这是一条不错的轮胎，尽管我在第一次自由练习（FP1）只跑了几圈，对中性胎并不太适应。所以，是的，我对这个选择很满意。”
倍耐力在周五就已经表示，C3和C4在耐久性方面相当接近，只有本周末可用的最硬配方C2是一个明显的台阶。
为什么勒克莱尔认为排位赛是法拉利在赞德沃特无法解决的弱点
除了轮胎选择之外，冲刺赛主要印证了勒克莱尔周五就已经有的想法：法拉利的正赛节奏不错，但排位赛被证明更加困难。
“我认为我们昨天在第一节自由练习中的节奏相当强劲，当时我们用中性胎做了长距离测试，所以我们知道我们有一辆很好的正赛车。”
"不过，在排位赛中我们还是稍有欠缺。我原本以为凭借这套软胎，我会在发车时超车而不是在比赛末段，但总的来说，这是一场相当不错的比赛。"
勒克莱尔在周五以第三快的时间给人留下深刻印象，但他仍然认为排位赛是法拉利的弱点之一。
随着能量部署策略日趋趋同，勒克莱尔认为在赞德沃特超车几乎是不可能的事。这使得排位赛的名次变得至关重要，也引出了一个问题：法拉利是否会牺牲一些比赛节奏来换取单圈速度的提升。
当被Motorsport.com问及此事时，勒克莱尔说："我想我们经常谈论如何让赛车在正赛或排位赛中更快，但我认为事情并没有那么非黑即白。"
"我认为你总是要尽力让赛车尽可能快，如果你做到了这一点，那么无论是对排位赛还是正赛都是有利的。然后还有一些细微的调校工作可以做，但我不会说这是决定性的改变，事情并不总是非黑即白的。"
"所以，回答你的问题，我认为目前我们没有办法解决这个问题、让赛车在排位赛中表现更好。我们知道这是一个弱点，但我们还没有找到解决方案。"
尽管勒克莱尔承认排位赛是法拉利的一个弱点，但他仍然成功地为冲刺赛拿到了发车位的第三名，仅落后杆位获得者拉塞尔0.055秒。
不过他强调，能否重演这一成绩远没有保证，因为勒克莱尔在冲刺排位赛第三节（SQ3）的那一圈跑得特别出色。
“我觉得昨天我跑了一个非常不错的单圈，赛车的状态也非常好。所以如果明天我们从杆位发车，我会感到惊讶，但我会竭尽全力让这件事成真。”
detailEn: "Either very right or very wrong" – Charles Leclerc explains Ferrari's bold choice for Dutch GP sprint

Leclerc admits he was concerned on the grid after opting for soft tyres, but stresses Ferrari’s race pace is generally strong. He describes qualifying as a "weakness" that cannot be fixed at Zandvoort

Although the Formula 1 sprint race at Zandvoort produced very little action, Charles Leclerc was responsible for one of the few overtakes. The Monegasque managed to pass Lando Norris for second place, where he eventually finished.

According to Leclerc, that overtake primarily came about because of differences in deployment, although given Leclerc’s tyre choice, it was still remarkable that he was able to complete a pass on lap 18 of 24.

After all, Leclerc was one of only two drivers who opted to start the shortest race of the weekend on soft tyres. That choice was based on data from practice and the fact that Ferrari generally looks good in terms of tyre degradation this weekend, at least on Leclerc’s side.
Nevertheless, Leclerc admitted he was somewhat concerned on the grid when he saw all the drivers around him lining up on mediums.
"Always when you are the only one doing something, it’s either very right or very wrong," Leclerc smiled.
"I think it was a good choice in the end, so that’s positive. It means that we did our homework well in FP1, but surely when I was on the grid, I just hoped to have made the right choice."
Leclerc surprised the other teams by maintaining a good race pace even at the end of the sprint race
The decision was made together with the team, although Leclerc stresses that it was not an easy one.
"Well, it wasn't because we had Lewis [Hamilton] and I on two different strategies. So surely it wasn't obvious.
"But I thought that it was a good tyre after FP1, even though I had done very few laps and I wasn't so comfortable with the medium. So yeah, I was happy with that choice."
Pirelli already indicated on Friday that the C3 and C4 are fairly close in terms of durability, with only the hardest compound available this weekend, the C2, representing a significant step.
Why Leclerc feels qualifying is a weakness Ferrari can’t fix in Zandvoort
Aside from the tyre choice, the sprint primarily underlined what Leclerc already thought on Friday: Ferrari’s race pace is good, but qualifying is proving more difficult.
"I think our pace had been quite strong yesterday in FP1 on the long runs, which we did on the medium, so we knew we had a good race car.
"However, in qualifying we are lacking a little bit. I was expecting to make positions at the start rather than at the end of the race with these soft tyres, but yeah, it was quite a good race."
Leclerc impressed on Friday with the third-fastest time, but still believes qualifying is one of Ferrari’s weaknesses

As the deployment strategies converge, Leclerc believes overtaking will be virtually impossible at Zandvoort. That makes qualifying position crucial and raises the question of whether Ferrari could sacrifice some race pace in order to improve its speed over a single lap.
"I think we often speak about how to make a car faster for a race or qualifying, but I don't think it's that black and white," Leclerc said when asked by Motorsport.com.

"I think you always try to make the car as fast as possible, and if you do that, then that's positive for qualifying and the race. Then there are slight finetuning things that you can do, but I wouldn't say it's a game changer, it's not always black and white.

"So, to reply to your question, I don't think there's anything we can do at the moment to fix it and have a better car in qualifying. We know it is a weakness, but we just didn't find the solution just yet."
Despite Leclerc describing qualifying as a weakness for Ferrari, he still managed to secure third on the grid for the sprint, just 0.055 seconds behind polesitter George Russell.
However, a repeat is far from guaranteed, he stresses, as Leclerc’s SQ3 lap was particularly strong.
"I think yesterday I did a really good lap and the car felt really good as well. So I'll be surprised if we start from pole tomorrow, but I'll do everything in my power to make it happen."

items.summaryZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔解释称，在F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中超越兰多·诺里斯获得第二名，得益于不同的能量部署策略。

items.originalTitle: 勒克莱尔揭秘超越“相当慢”的诺里斯之关键
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc explained that he was able to overtake Lando Norris for second place in the Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix sprint race thanks to different energy deployment strategies.
detailZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔超越“相当慢的”兰多·诺里斯的关键所在
能量部署在勒克莱尔成功争夺赞德福特F1冲刺赛第二名的过程中至关重要
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利；兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
夏尔·勒克莱尔解释说，他能够在F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中超越兰多·诺里斯获得第二名，靠的是不同的能量部署策略。
由于冲刺赛赛制，各车队几乎没有时间微调他们的能量管理设置，在排位赛首轮开始前只有一节自由练习。
勒克莱尔认为，他的迈凯伦对手在主直道上缺乏电量输出，是他在第18圈1号弯得以完成超越、升至第二名的关键因素。
“兰多在主直道上相当慢，”这位法拉利车手说，“他的电量输出不如我。所以我知道在前两圈之后那里会有机会。”
最终，勒克莱尔在比赛结束时将领先诺里斯的差距拉开到四秒，但未能对乔治·拉塞尔构成挑战，在格子旗挥动时落后1.360秒。
当被问及是否认为自己也能超过那辆梅赛德斯时，这位摩纳哥车手回答说：“嗯，我相信有可能。但两三圈之后他开始更加用力地推进，我就知道要超过去会很困难。
“我看到乔治（George）在主直道上采用了不同的能量部署方式，这意味着对我来说想要超车始终会非常困难，即使我已经贴得很近了。”
对于迈凯伦来说，能量管理根本不是他们最担心的问题，因为MCL40赛车在低速弯道中表现挣扎，进而导致轮胎衰减严重——这也是为什么勒克莱尔（Leclerc）尽管使用的是较软的轮胎，诺里斯（Norris）在比赛后段仍未能挡住他的另一个原因。
此外，车手们预计部署策略将会趋于一致，因为各车队会在正式排位赛（届时将进入封闭停车区状态）和正赛之前再次对赛车进行调整。
“在像今年这样有新赛车的年份，这肯定是一个很大的差异化因素，我们今天也看到了。我认为在赞德福特这里几乎不可能超车。如果各车队之间没有不同的功率输出策略，我根本不可能完成那次超车，”勒克莱尔说，他对诺里斯的超越是前15名车手中发生的唯一一次超越。
“不过，到了周日，我们似乎都会趋同到一个比较接近的状态。所以我不指望明天会有很大的差异。
“而且纵观整个赛季，前两三场比赛我们看到到处都有不少缠斗，因为我认为当时大家都不太确定正确的做法是什么。现在，大家似乎又或多或少地趋同了。”
“是的，我想从明天开始大家都会趋同，”冲刺赛冠军乔治·拉塞尔表示赞同。“而且在你获得轮胎优势之前，超车可能会比较困难。”
detailEn: The key to Charles Leclerc overtaking a “quite slow” Lando Norris
Energy deployment was crucial in Leclerc’s successful bid for second place in the Zandvoort F1 sprint
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren
Charles Leclerc explained he was able to overtake Lando Norris for second place in Formula 1’s Dutch Grand Prix sprint race courtesy of different deployment strategies.
Teams had little time to fine-tune their energy management set-ups due to the sprint format, with just one free practice session ahead of the opening round of qualifying.
Leclerc believes his McLaren counterpart’s lack of deployment on the main straight was instrumental in facilitating his move for second place in Turn 1 on lap 18.
“Lando on the main straight was quite slow,” the Ferrari driver said. “He didn't have the deployment that I had. So, I knew there was an opportunity there after the first two laps.”
Leclerc eventually pulled away from Norris by four seconds at the end of the race, but failed to mount a challenge to George Russell, ending up 1.360s down under the chequered flag.

Asked if he thought he could pass the Mercedes too, the Monegasque replied: “Well, I believed in it. But after two or three laps he started to push a little bit more and I knew it was going to be difficult.
“I saw that George had a different kind of deployment on the main straight, which meant that it was always going to be very difficult for me to get past, even if I was getting very close.”

Energy management was the least of McLaren’s worries as the MCL40 struggled in low-speed corners and, consequently, with tyre degradation – another reason why Norris failed to hold off Leclerc late on despite the latter running soft rubber.
Furthermore, drivers are expecting deployment strategies to converge as teams tweak their cars again ahead of the main qualifying session, when parc ferme comes into force, and the race.

“Surely it's a big differentiator on a year like this year with these new cars, and we've seen it today. I think here in Zandvoort it's close to impossible to overtake. And I could have never made the overtake if there wasn't a different deployment strategy between teams,” Leclerc said, with his move on Norris the only pass that occurred in the top 15 positions.
“However, we seem to all converge to a kind of similar place coming Sunday. So I don't expect big differences coming tomorrow.

“And also throughout the season, we've seen the first two, three races, there was a lot of action, a bit everywhere, because I think everybody was not so sure about what was the right thing to do. Now, again, everybody seems to converge more or less in the same place.”
“Yeah, I think everyone's going to converge from tomorrow,” sprint winner George Russell concurred. “And it will probably be a bit challenging to overtake until you get that tyre advantage.”

items.summaryZh: 卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯表示，迈凯伦在赞德福特冲刺赛中的低速弯道弱点使其表现“远不够好”，无法挑战胜利。

media.altZh: “远不够好”——迈凯伦对荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛挣扎感到困惑

items.originalTitle: “远不够好”——迈凯伦对荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛挣扎感到困惑
items.summaryEn: Reigning world champion Lando Norris says McLaren's low-speed weaknesses meant it was nowhere near good enough to challenge for victory in the Zandvoort sprint race.
detailZh: "远远不够好"——迈凯伦对荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛的挣扎感到困惑
兰多·诺里斯呼吁他的迈凯伦F1车队提升低速性能，此前他在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中处于被动
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯表示，迈凯伦在低速状态下的弱点意味着它在赞德福特冲刺赛中"远远不够好"，无法去争夺胜利
迈凯伦带着其最新升级包来到这座海滨赛道，升级重点集中在赛车尾部，包括一套新的尾翼组件，以延续其在匈牙利站助力夺胜的升级所带来的进步。
最初的迹象表明升级奏效了，周五迈凯伦有力争夺冲刺排位赛杆位，乔治·拉塞尔以不到0.1秒的优势击败了第二名诺里斯和第四快的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
但在周六的比赛中，诺里斯并没有去追击拉塞尔，而是很快被法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔逼入防守，勒克莱尔是唯一使用软胎而非中性胎起步的前排车手。耐人寻味的是，勒克莱尔在这场24圈的比赛中并没有在软胎寿命末期衰减，反而不断施压，直到在第18圈开始时完成对诺里斯的超越。
迈凯伦在对手使用更容易衰退的轮胎的情况下后轮管理反而更差，这是一个危险信号，沃金车队正努力在周六下午排位赛前解决这一问题，各车队还有最后一次机会重新调整赛车设置。
迈凯伦车队领队安德里亚·斯特拉告诉天空体育：“我们必须承认，到目前为止，我们的表现似乎在单圈上要好于连续多圈。我们因为后轮衰退而损失了性能，还有一些低速性能需要改进。”
"我们需要查明为什么我们的后轮胎退化如此严重，这可能与赛车调校和整体驾驶风格有关，而不一定是轮胎配方的问题，所以确实有几个变量需要我们深入研究，并在本周末剩下的时间里进行优化。"
诺里斯（Norris）对他的MCL40在低速状态下的劣势感到沮丧，这使他无法匹敌拉塞尔（Russell）和勒克莱尔（Leclerc）。"总的来说我就是没有速度，尤其是在低速弯角，"他耸了耸肩说。"和其他车队相比，我们挣扎得太厉害了。到目前为止整个周末我们都是这样看到的。"
"我们无能为力。这辆车在高速时非常出色，但在低速时远远不够好，所以要跟上别人非常困难。我们在正赛中不能在高速路段过度压榨，因此也无法发挥我们的优势。"
他补充道："我想在布达佩斯我们就知道自己在高速弯很有优势，而在低速时相当糟糕，但我们还是赢了。这里极低速的弯角多得多。所以不，我一点也不惊讶。这完全在我们的预料之中。"
斯特拉表示，迈凯伦后轮的衰竭和它在低速状态下的表现很可能有关联，但他也指出，这个差距比最初预想的要严重。
"我们完全没有预料到这一点，"他承认道。"我们看到，在排位赛的叠加数据中，赛车现在在高速方面表现非常好，但低速显然仍是一个有待提升的领域。所以，我认为今天在多圈行驶中，这个低速方面的差距导致我们的轮胎衰竭，并让我们暴露在被其他赛车超越的风险之下。"
在另一辆迈凯伦赛车上，皮亚斯特里在发车时被基米·安东内利超越，并跟在这位意大利车手之后以第五名完赛。对于周六赛车缺乏竞争力这件事，他比诺里斯更加感到意外。
"我们的表现不太好，尤其是在那次冲刺赛的后半段，所以这有点令人意外，"这位澳大利亚车手说。
"昨天，我们觉得如果对我们两人来说单圈成绩能稍微好一点，我们本可以占据前排发车位，所以今天没有这样的速度有点令人意外。但希望我们能排位顺利，然后在明天坚持得更好一些。"
detailEn: "Nowhere near good enough" - McLaren puzzled by Dutch GP sprint struggles
Lando Norris is calling on his McLaren Formula 1 team to improve its low-speed performance after being on the back foot in the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race
Reigning world champion Lando Norris says McLaren's low-speed weaknesses meant it was "nowhere near good enough" to challenge for victory in Zandvoort's sprint race.

McLaren arrived at the beach-side circuit with its latest upgrade package focusing on the rear of the car, including a new rear wing assembly, to build on the progress made by its race-winning Hungary upgrades.

The first indications pointed towards the upgrade working as expected, with McLaren firmly in the hunt for sprint pole on Friday as George Russell defeated both second-placed Norris and fourth-fastest Oscar Piastri by less than a tenth.

But instead of hunting down Russell in Saturday's race, Norris was quickly put on the defensive by Ferrari's Charles Leclerc, who was the only frontrunner to start on soft tyres rather than mediums. Intriguingly, Leclerc didn't fade on his softer tyres towards the end of the 24-lap contest, but actually increased the pressure until he could reel off an overtake on Norris at the start of lap 18.

McLaren's inferior rear tyre management against a competitor on more brittle tyres is a red flag which the Woking squad is trying to get on top of ahead of Saturday afternoon qualifying, with teams afforded one more chance to overhaul their car set-ups.

"We have to admit that our performance so far seems to be better over a single lap than in continuous laps," McLaren team principal Andrea Stella told Sky. "We were losing performance because of rear tyre degradation, some low-speed performance to improve.

"We need to look as to why we have so much rear tyre degradation, which rather than compound might have to do with car set-up and overall driving style, so certainly a few variables that we need to look into and optimise for the rest of the weekend."

Norris sounded frustrated by his MCL40's low-speed deficit which left him unable to match Russell and Leclerc. "I just don't have the pace in general, especially the slow-speed corners," he shrugged. "We struggled so much compared to the others. We saw that the whole weekend so far.

"There's nothing we can do. The car is very good in high speed and it's just nowhere near good enough for slow speed, so to be able to keep up was very difficult. We can't over-push in high speed during the race and therefore we can't optimise our strengths."

He added: "I think we knew in Budapest we were very good in high-speed corners and we were pretty terrible in slow speed, but we still managed to win. Here there's a lot more of the very, very slow speed. So no, I'm not surprised at all. It's exactly what we expected."
McLaren's rear tyre degradation and its low-speed performance are very likely linked, Stella says, but he did point out its deficit is more dramatic than first thought.

"We didn't expect it entirely," he acknowledged. "We saw that in qualifying in the overlays the car is now performing very well in high speed, but definitely low speed is still an area of opportunity. So, I think today over multiple laps this low-speed deficit meant that we were degrading the tyres and exposed us to being overtaken by other cars."

In the other McLaren, Piastri, who was passed at the start by Kimi Antonelli and followed the Italian home in fifth place, was also more surprised than Norris by his car's lack of competitiveness on Saturday.
"We didn't look great, especially in the second half of that sprint, so it's a little bit surprising," the Australian said.

"Yesterday, we thought with some slightly better laps for both of us we could have been on the front row, so it's a little bit surprising to not have the pace today. But hopefully we can qualify well and then hang on a bit better tomorrow."

items.titleZh: 林德布拉德：赞德福特冲刺赛不会太精彩
items.summaryZh: 阿尔维德·林德布拉德表示，赞德福特冲刺赛缺乏超车并不意外，但他认为这场比赛对自己的练习很有价值。

items.originalTitle: 林德布拉德：赞德福特冲刺赛不会太精彩
items.summaryEn: Arvid Lindblad said he was not surprised the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race lacked action, but he found the session useful for practice.
detailZh: 阿尔维德·林德布拉德对荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛缺乏动作并不感到意外。
首圈之后，前半段车阵中仅发生了一次位置变化。林德布拉德整场比赛都跟在加布里埃尔·博托莱托身后。
“我想我们都知道，在赞德福特举行的冲刺赛可能不会是最精彩的比赛，”林德布拉德说。
本周末的冲刺赛是F1今年六场冲刺赛中的第五场。这是赞德福特首次举办冲刺赛，尽管该赛道没有在未来举办另一场大奖赛的合同。
尽管自己的比赛中缺乏动作，林德布拉德表示这场比赛对练习很有用。“这让我在一条对我来说全新的赛道上又跑了20、25圈，这对本周末剩余的时间将非常有用，”他说。
“我认为速度老实说比预期的要好。我们通常在正赛中的表现比排位赛更挣扎一些，考虑到我们在排位赛中已经不太好了，能够相当有竞争力，相当轻松地跟住前面的两个人，我认为还不错。
“所以让我们看看本周末剩余的时间，但我们知道我们可以向前迈进一步。我知道我还能做得更好。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘是另一位整场比赛都无法挑战前车的车手。“我只是有点被困在奥斯卡[皮亚斯特里]后面，”他说。“在这里，一旦你接近，轮胎就会过热，你就无法超车，所以你就只能被困住。”
detailEn: Arvid Lindblad was not surprised the Dutch Grand prix sprint race lacked action.
Only a single position change occured in the top half of the field after the first lap. Lindblad spent his entire race behind Gabriel Bortoleto.
“I think we all knew a sprint race at Zandvoort’s probably not going to be the most exciting race,” said Lindblad.

This weekend’s sprint race is the fifth of the six Formula 1 will hold this year. It is the first time Zandvoort has held a sprint race, though the track does not have a contract to hold another grand prix in the future.

Despite the lack of action in his race, Lindblad said the session was useful for practice. “It’s another 20, 25 laps under my belt on a new track for me which is going to very useful for the rest of the weekend,” he said.

“I think the pace is honestly better than expected. We normally struggle a little bit more in the race than quali and considering we already weren’t great in quali, to be quite competitive, quite easily able to hang on to the two guys in front I think was decent.
“So let’s see for the rest of the weekend, but we know we can make a step forward. I know there’s more to come from me.”

Max Verstappen was another driver who spent his enter race unable to challenge the driver ahead of him. “I just got a bit stuck behind Oscar [Piastri],” he said. “Around here, as soon as you get close your tyres overheat and you can’t pass, so you’re just stuck.”
keyPointsZh: 冲刺赛首圈后，前半段车阵中仅发生一次位置变化，林德布拉德全程跟在加布里埃尔·博托莱托身后。
这是赞德福特首次举办冲刺赛，也是本赛季六场冲刺赛中的第五场，该赛道未来没有举办大奖赛的合同。
马克斯·维斯塔潘也表示自己整场比赛被困在奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里身后，一旦接近轮胎就会过热而无法超车。
keyPointsEn: Only one position change occurred in the top half of the field after the first lap, and Lindblad spent his entire race behind Gabriel Bortoleto.
This was Zandvoort's first sprint race, the fifth of six this year, and the track does not have a contract to hold another grand prix in the future.
Max Verstappen also said he spent his entire race stuck behind Oscar Piastri, as getting close caused his tyres to overheat and prevented passing.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: F1在赞德沃特举行的首次也是最后一次冲刺赛过程沉闷，但仍产生了赢家与输家。文章认为这提醒F1在2027年选择哪些分站采用冲刺赛形式时必须谨慎。
items.originalTitle: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛赢家与输家
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's first and last sprint race at Zandvoort was far from a classic, but it still produced winners and losers. The author argues it serves as a warning that F1 must be careful when choosing which races get the sprint format in 2027.
detailZh: F1历史上第一次（也是最后一次）在荷兰大奖赛举办的冲刺赛很难称得上经典，但它确实产生了一些赢家和输家。
2027年我们将会有更多冲刺赛，虽然仅凭这场在赞德沃特举行的乏味比赛来评判这一决定并不公平，但这至少是一个警告：F1在选择哪些分站获得冲刺赛待遇时必须非常谨慎。
在这种所谓的“比赛”里，我见过超跑巡游都比这更有动作。在前列，勒克莱尔从内侧切入超越兰多·诺里斯，是唯一一次不借助发车完成的超车——而在发车时，基米·安东内利超过了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。弗兰科·科拉平托也在发车时抢占了角田裕毅的位次，来到第12位。
尼克·霍肯伯格退役的奥迪车和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯的病恹恹的凯迪拉克，甚至也在下游帮助了一些车手提升了名次。
一场糟糕透顶的比赛，我只希望排位赛和正赛能更好一些，好让赞德沃特在离开赛历时得到一场更配得上它的F1告别赛。因为就这场冲刺赛来看，我很高兴它要走了，而这实在不公平，也很令人难过。—— Jack Benyon
感谢老天，夏尔·勒克莱尔大胆决定在赞德沃特冲刺赛上使用软胎，而且居然敢……完成一次超车！太令人震惊了。
这是比赛后半段对诺里斯的一次漂亮的操作，不过勒克莱尔认为这次超车之所以能成功，是因为他看出诺里斯在直道上的能量输出没有他那么多。也许能量输出的策略和执行方式将成为贯穿整个周末的主题。
使用软胎本应带来起步阶段的优势和末段轮胎衰退时的劣势，但勒克莱尔的情况看起来恰恰相反，他觉得自己和车队在软胎上做的“功课”得到了印证。
最终，他的起步不佳，影响了前段的推进，但Leclerc和他的法拉利赛车让软胎的保持状态比一些使用中性胎的车手更久、更好，这对于正赛日来说是一个耐人寻味的前景。——JB
诺里斯的后轮在这场冲刺赛刚过三分之一的时候似乎突然急剧衰减，而皮亚斯特里在第五位上完全隐身，这表明迈凯伦今天的速度并不够快。
两位车手分别都是这场比赛中仅有的两次有意义的超车的受害者。
希望他们从中吸取了教训，并能应用到正赛中，因为如果中性胎衰减得这么快的情况持续下去，周日对他们来说可能会很艰难。——JB
无论乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）在夏天做了什么（也许是他的订婚），他从夏休期归来时焕然一新，并且完全具备了所需的心态，去抓住那些能让他保住争冠希望的成绩。
他在赞德沃特冲刺赛夺得的杆位和胜利（这是他今年五站中第三次包揽杆位和胜利），得益于排位赛中的完美执行以及比赛中一些聪明的轮胎管理——这表明他重新与W17赛车人车合一了。
他与基米·安东内利（安东内利）的积分差距仍然很大（56分），他也需要一些运气的眷顾，但拉塞尔已经证明，自己远未从不尽如人意的赛季上半程中出局。 - 乔恩·诺布尔
这个排名并不能很好地反映利亚姆·劳森（劳森）在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中的表现，因为在阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad）在首圈抵挡住他的进攻后，他已无能为力。
此后，对Lawson来说这是一场令人沮丧的比赛，他始终无法对他平时的队友造成任何影响。
归根结底，Lawson的失利源于周五未能进入SQ3，而在大奖赛排位赛中闯入前十将是他确保自己不会在周日再次陷入困境的关键目标——到目前为止，这次替补出场的周末已经算是'相当体面'了。但要让它升级为'精彩'级别，他还需要做得更多。 - Josh Suttill
与发车网格上的大多数车手一样，这个成绩源于排位赛：搭载升级件的阿尔派车手Gasly在排位中领先中游集团，并在比赛中保持了这一位置。
鉴于超车机会寥寥，你不必对这场比赛做过多的解读。但尽管早早承受压力，Gasly还是能够将领先博托莱托的差距拉大到接近两秒。
对于一支在小红牛的升级把它挤到队内排序之前、一直感觉无所适从的车队来说，这是积极的信号。——JB
由于“从一开始就出现动力问题”，冲刺赛只跑完了七圈，霍肯伯格是里程方面最大的输家。
从第14位发车，他本来就不太可能拿分，但他确实需要跑圈来理解周五那场令人费解的SQ2出局——他自己几乎没有答案可以解释。——JS
detailEn: Formula 1's first (and last) ever sprint race at the Dutch Grand Prix was hardly a classic, but it did produce some winners and losers.

We’re going to have more sprint races in 2027, and while it wouldn’t be fair to judge that decision based purely on this turgid Zandvoort race, it’s at least a warning that F1 has to be very careful in choosing which races get the sprint treatment.

I’ve seen more action in supercar parades than this so-called 'race'. Up front, Leclerc’s dive down the inside of Lando Norris was the only overtake not assisted by the start, in which Kimi Antonelli jumped Oscar Piastri. Franco Colapinto also mugged Yuki Tsunoda at the start for 12th.
The retiring Audi of Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez’s ailing Cadillac even assisted some of the rises up the order further down, too.

An awful race and I only hope qualifying and the race is better to give Zandvoort a more fitting F1 send-off as it leaves the calendar. Because based on that sprint, I’m happy it’s leaving, and that’s really not fair and very sad. - Jack Benyon
Thank goodness for Charles Leclerc’s gamble to wear soft tyres for the Zandvoort sprint, and to have the audacity to…make an overtake! Shocking.

It was a strong move on Norris in the second half of the race, although Leclerc reckoned it was boosted because he could see Norris didn’t have as much deployment on the straight as he did. Perhaps that will be a theme that runs through this weekend in terms of deployment styles and execution.

Using the soft tyres should have produced a gain at the start and a loss as they degraded at the end, but it looked the opposite for Leclerc, and he felt he and the team were vindicated by the “homework” they did on the softs.

Ultimately, he had a bad start which hampered early progress, but Leclerc and the Ferrari kept the softs in better condition for longer than some of the medium runners, which is an intriguing prospect for race day. - JB

Lando Norris’s rear tyres appeared to fall off a cliff just over a third of the way into this sprint race, and Oscar Piastri’s total anonymity in fifth just showed McLaren didn’t quite have the pace today.
Both drivers were victims of the only two meaningful overtakes of the race, respectively.
Hopefully they have learned a lesson from this that they can apply to the race as struggling that quickly on the mediums might make Sunday difficult for them if that continues. - JB

Whatever George Russell did over the summer (and maybe it was his engagement), he has returned from the summer break refreshed and with exactly the mental approach needed to grab the results that keep his title hopes alive.

His Zandvoort sprint pole and victory (the third time out of five he has done the double this year) were helped by perfect execution in qualifying and some clever tyre management in the race – showing he is back at one with the W17.

The points deficit to Kimi Antonelli is still big (56), and he is going to need a bit of luck on his side, but Russell has shown he is far down and out from a first half to the campaign that did not go to plan. - Jon Noble
This placement isn't much of a reflection of Liam Lawson's driving in the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race, as he couldn't do much once Arvid Lindblad fended off his attack on the opening lap.
Thereafter, it was a frustrating race for Lawson, who couldn't make any impression on his usual team-mate.

Ultimately, Lawson was doomed by not making it into SQ3 on Friday and breaking into the top 10 will be the key goal for grand prix qualifying to ensure he doesn't get stuck again on Sunday of what's been a 'very respectable' stand-in weekend so far. But he'll need to do more than this to tip it into 'spectacular' territory. - Josh Suttill
As with most drivers on the grid, this result was born out of qualifying, where the upgraded Alpine of Gasly led the midfield, and maintained that during the race.
Given the lack of overtaking, you wouldn’t want to read too much into this race. But despite early pressure, Gasly was able to gap Gabriel Bortoleto to the tune of nearly two seconds by the end.
Positive signs for a team which has felt in no-man’s-land while Racing Bulls’ upgrades had shoved it ahead in the pecking order. - JB
With just seven laps completed in the sprint thanks to a "power issue right from the beginning", Nico Hulkenberg is the biggest loser in mileage terms.
He was always unlikely to score points from 14th on the grid, but he did need laps to understand his baffling SQ2 exit on Friday, which he had very few answers to explain. - JS

items.originalTitle: 帕尔默警告拉塞尔：2026年或是最佳夺冠机会
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver Jolyon Palmer has warned George Russell that he must capitalise on his 2026 championship fight, as it might be his best-ever shot at the title. F1 resumes this weekend at Zandvoort with the Dutch Grand Prix, which features the sprint format.
detailZh: Jolyon Palmer就F1总冠军向拉塞尔发出警告：'这可能是他有史以来最好的机会'
Jolyon Palmer认为，拉塞尔必须抓住他2026年的夺冠机会，这位梅赛德斯车手正力争缩小与总冠军领跑者安东内利之间的差距
据前F1车手Jolyon Palmer所说，拉塞尔必须充分利用他2026年的冠军争夺战，他警告这位梅赛德斯车手可能再也不会有更好的夺冠机会。
F1本周末将在赞德沃特重启，迎来采用冲刺赛赛制的荷兰大奖赛。随着夏休期后围场重新集结，Russell落后于他的梅赛德斯队友、总冠军领跑者安东内利 59分。七届总冠军汉密尔顿在积分榜上位居这两位梅赛德斯车手之间。
拉塞尔在2026赛季的开局相当艰难。虽然他赢得了揭幕战澳大利亚大奖赛和中国站冲刺赛，但他遭遇了一连串的霉运，而他的队友则连续五场大奖赛夺冠。赛季上半程，拉塞尔拿下两场大奖赛胜利，而安东内利则拿下了六场。
“自墨尔本以来，他过得并不轻松，他需要重新调整，”帕尔默在F1 TV的Weekend Warm-Up节目中解释道。
“所以，这正是完美的时机。你有几周的强制休赛期。去别的地方度过，而且心里还有一件大事，”他补充道，指的是拉塞尔向交往多年的伴侣卡门·蒙特罗·蒙德求婚一事。
“而且他确实需要做出回应。压力不仅在于争夺冠军的基米，也在于同样争夺冠军的乔治。这是他有史以来最好的机会。这可能仍将是他在F1中改变局面的最好机会。所以现在是时候抛弃各种借口，把成绩写在纸面上了。”
拉塞尔为荷兰大奖赛周末开了一个好头。在为冲刺赛夺得杆位后，他成功防住了迈凯伦的诺里斯和法拉利的勒克莱尔，拿下胜利，这是他本赛季的第三个冲刺赛冠军。
detailEn: Jolyon Palmer warns George Russell over F1 title: 'Might be his best-ever shot'
Jolyon Palmer believes George Russell must capitalise on his 2026 title opportunity as the Mercedes driver looks to close the gap to championship leader Kimi Antonelli
George Russell must capitalise on his 2026 championship fight, according to former Formula 1 driver Jolyon Palmer, who warns the Mercedes driver may never get a better title opportunity.

F1 resumes this weekend at Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix, which features the sprint format. As the paddock reconvenes following the summer break, Russell trails his Mercedes team-mate and championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 59 points. Seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton splits the two Mercedes drivers in the standings.

Russell has endured a difficult start to his 2026 campaign. While he won the season-opening Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese sprint race, he suffered a string of bad luck while his team-mate claimed five consecutive grand prix wins. In the first half of the season, Russell secured two grand prix wins, whereas Antonelli took six.
"It's not been easy for him since Melbourne, and he needs to reset," Palmer explained during the F1 TV Weekend Warm-Up show.

"So, it's the perfect thing. You have a few weeks of enforced shutdown. Go and spend it away, something big on your mind as well," he added, referring to Russell's proposal to his long-term partner Carmen Montero Mundt.

"And he does need a response. The pressure is not only on Kimi with the title; it's on George with the title as well. This is his best-ever shot. It might stay as his best-ever shot in Formula 1 to make the difference here. So now is the time that the excuses have got to go and you've got to put it on the paper."

Russell has kicked off the Dutch Grand Prix weekend on a positive note. After securing pole position for the sprint race, he successfully defended against McLaren's Lando Norris and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc to take victory, his third sprint win of the season.
